counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands

problems: Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire row (1969-1995) still contains 70 of Fiji's 83 land cells and 78 of the Solomon Islands' 110 in 1980; eu-11 should end both in 1970 and 1978.
Cliopatria's United States of America row (1967-2005) still contains Pohnpei and Palau's main cell; am-07 should end the Trust Territory in 1986 (FSM) and 1994 (Palau).

Every one of the five Cliopatria rows starts 3-9 years after independence, and every shape is verdict adjust (simplified outlines drop islands at the gazetteer's grid; the Micronesia shape is Pohnpei only). Each dossier starts at independence with a new keyframe for the gap years.

Cliopatria's Wikipedia/Wikidata fields for Micronesia ('Micronesia', Q3359409) point at the region, not the state; identity.wikipedia is 'Federated States of Micronesia' and the wikidata value is kept unchecked.

Ten distinct Wikipedia pages were opened (sources_total 11 counts the page lists of the five dossiers; the Trust Territory page serves two); one page failed. The Santo secession of 1980 is a contest, not a rebel dossier (about 12 weeks).
